# Vendored libmysofa reader subset

This directory contains the minimum upstream **libmysofa v1.3.4** reader/HDF subset required for native SOFA file decoding in Notch Sixty.

Upstream: `hoene/libmysofa`, tag `v1.3.4`.

License: BSD 3-Clause. The exact upstream `LICENSE` is retained here.

Notch Sixty does not vendor upstream sample SOFA datasets. Product-specific validation and conversion live outside this directory.
